rf_chain.measurement_plane: generator / 50-ohm side of the LOCAL matching network

match.value: adjustable local match, on / immediately adjacent to the ICP module (match_colocated = true)
match.location_evidence: DCR-DBF1-003 evaluation (lane-dcr003-match, external, read 2026-10-09): R-1 co-located match isolated from the ICP bracket with its own radiator is admissible; R-2 remote match is not (matched-line loss into the unmatched antenna leaves eta_line 0.02-0.93). The bench therefore keeps the match local (DBF1-RF-03 unchanged) and builds the R-1 isolation as the bench mount (Ti standoffs, plated RF lead), so the bench match thermal state is flight-representative.
match.tuning: two adjustable elements re-tuned per set point to minimum reflection (TK-23 practice); position encoders logged (INS-P2-12)

diagnostics.method: P2 ZM-A (V/I probe), ZM-B (de-embedded reflection, VNA), ZM-C (antenna current + delivered power, R_p = R_hot - R_cold at equal antenna temperature)

requirement.basis: half the gap between the published anchor eta_p 0.1 (TK-26) and the lowest analog-needed Xe value 0.18 (closure M-C), at k = 2: separates them (selected engineering value, proposed for registration)
requirement.relation: eta_p = R_p / (R_p + R_ant) = 1 - R_cold / R_hot (P2 ZM-C, anchor Eq. (1)); u(eta_p) = (1 - eta_p) sqrt(u_rel(R_cold)^2 + u_rel(R_hot)^2)

safety_isolation.rf_permissives: RF output is inhibited unless all permissives are true: chamber vacuum OK, valid ICP MODULE_ID, coax/connector interlock loop closed, reflected power below its trip, collector/bias supply in a defined state, Hall discharge supply in the state required by the sequence. Trip values are set from measured S1a behaviour, never invented. Every trip is logged with time and cause (row 62).
safety_isolation.personnel: shielded antenna and enclosure, RF leakage survey before first power (P1-SI-04); HV hipot current limited (P1-SI-11); oxygen-deficiency assessment for Ar / N2 / Xe release (P1-SI-07)
